process.title: How we work.
process.subtitle: Four steps. No useless meetings, no slideware.

1.title: 30-min brief
1.body: We get your project, deadline, budget. You leave with a clear plan.

2.title: Fixed quote
2.body: Within 24 working hours. Scope, timeline, price. No hidden costs.

3.title: Build
3.body: Kickoff within 7 days. Regular demos, direct access on Slack or WhatsApp.

4.title: Ship
4.body: Go live, training, docs. 14 days of support included for tweaks.

maisonPilates.pitch: Online Pilates studio. Catalog, seasonal sales, polished product journey.

q1.q: How long does it take to ship?
q1.a: 1 to 8 weeks depending on the project. Kickoff within 7 days of sign-off, regular demos along the way.

q2.q: Do you handle copy, content, and design?
q2.a: Yes on demand. We can take care of copywriting and design, or work alongside your team and existing partners.

q3.a: Always. You get the Git repo, hosting account, service credentials. No lock-in.

q4.a: Web: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, Stripe, Vercel. Mobile: React Native + Expo. Shopify: Liquid + Hydrogen.

q5.q: How do we collaborate during the project?
q5.a: Direct Slack or WhatsApp, regular demos, a preview environment that's always live. No committees, no 12-layer Gantt charts.

q6.a: We stay reachable for 14 days for tweaks. After that you can sign a maintenance contract, or take over — it's your code.
